tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin yang gsang gi bdag bskyed phyag bzhi ma ning rnam sras rnams kyi gtor bsngo bskang ba phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa sna tshogs gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'dir spu hrang dgon gyi bstan srung rnams la mchod gtor bya tshul cung zad brjod na/ bdag bskyed bla med yi dam gang rung gis chog kyang / sngar rta mgrin yang gsang yang byed srol byung 'dug pas de'i dbang du btang nas/ rten rnams kyi drung stegs bu bang rim can la dpal bshos snying gzugs ma sha mar dar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i g.yas su bdud rtsi/ g.yon du rak+ta/ de nas gur zhal gyi gtor ma/ phyag bzhi pa'i gtor ma snying gzugs ma gnyis dang zlum gtor gnyis/ ma ning la gru gsum 'khor brgyad ma/ rnam sras la zlum gtor 'khor brgyad ma/ gzhan yang ni ber dang rdo rje'i mched mo/ gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtor ma'ang mthong brgyud bzhin bsham pa'i mdun chu gnyis nyer mchod bshams la/ bdag bskyed ni/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas par khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ 'bring po yab yum rkyang sgrub/ bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa dang gsum byung ba las 'dir yab yum rkyang sgrub rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas rten gyi gang zag 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyis 'dug stangs kyis gnas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par dmigs te/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞

dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang / bai ros/ pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /pad+ma dbang chen bsgom bzlas ni/ /bdag gi sems can don du bgyi/ /zhes tshar gsum gyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / bai ros/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal med gyur cig /sems can bde la rtag par gnas/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /ces pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi pad+ma dbang chen du gsal bas/ oṃ raṃ badz+ra kro dha rak+sha dz+wa la raṃ tik+ṇa bi shwa dz+wa la/ phaṭa raṃ raṃ raṃ a/ oṃ a ha ra a ha ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhupe hūm̐/ thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ phyag rgya rdo rje thal mo kha phye/ oṃ mahā ba ling ta pū dza te dz+wa hūm̐/ thal mo kha phye/ oṃ mahā pad+ma rak+ta hūm̐/ pad+ma 'khyil ba rnams kyi mthar se gol bya'o/ /sman gtor rak+ta'i sngags rnams lan gsum re/ zhes pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shudha sarba dharma swa bha wa bi shu dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ pad+ma man+ḍa la/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ a tsan+d+ra man+ḍa la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rū tra baṃ/ bdud nag pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa sa bon gyi yig 'bru hrīḥdamar po dang / maṃ sngon por gyur/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gnas gsum nas rdo rje gsum gyis ngo bo yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum spyan drangs/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/

tshur 'dus yig 'bru la thim pas/ pad+ma dmar po dang / bhan+dha khrag gis gang ba'i rnam par gyur/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brtan par byas/ hrīḥm hā kro dha ha ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar nag g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba'i rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor rta mgo ljang khu/ rngog ma dmar po/ phuṃ phuṃ ser po/ zhur dkar po/ rta skad drag po lhang lhang 'tsher ba/ smin ma dang sma ra'i ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / g.yon gyi dang po ban+dha khrag gis gang ba bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa g.yas gnyis pas lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis pas rgyu ma'i zhags pa/ g.yas gsum pas tsan+dan gyi be con dang / g.yon gsum pas ral gri rab tu 'bar ba 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / tshal bu'i dpung rgyan/ skam po/ rlon pa/ rid pa ste thod phreng tshar gsum gyi do shal can/ sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang / glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol ba/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyis tshom bu bkod pa/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i khyung gshog sngon pos bar snang khyab pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par/ zhabs g.yas gnyis bskum zhing / g.yon gnyis brkyang ba'i gyad kyi 'dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ban+dha khrag gang yongs su gyur ba la/

de'i pang na yum chen pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mi'i snying rlon pa bzung nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa dung chen dmar 'khyil yab kyi zhal du stobs pa/ spyan gsum khrag mig tu blta ba/ zhal bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa nag po mun pa ltar 'thibs pas sku sked yan chad non pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis spras pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ bskal ba'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ yab kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen khrag 'thung yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pad+ma shwa ri sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhupe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta pra ti ts+tsha ye swāhā/ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā his phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstims pas dam tshig pa ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rang gi spyi bor hūm̐ sngon po las badz+ra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ oṃ bud+dha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ mtshog mar oṃ dkar po las bud+dha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ swā rat+na he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/

rna ltag g.yas par swā ser po las rat+na he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ paṃ pad+ma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ltag par paṃ dmar po las pad+ma he ru ka dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ ha karma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ sna ltag g.yon par ha ljang gu las karma he ru ka ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de lnga ka'ang thod skam gyi khang bu re re'i nang na bzhugs pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas sngar ltar sngags tsam gyi phyi mchod dang / chu gnyis nyer mchod rol chen sman raka gtor ma rnams kyi sngags 'gor mtshan sngags re re sbyar/ sngags kyi rjes su/ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā bā liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes pas sman raka gtor gsum gyis mchod/ rgyas par rtags bstod dam/ bsdu na/ kun mkhyen mus sred pas mdzad pa'i/ hrīḥ rdor dril 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas pas/ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor na/ /pad+ma nyi zla bdud bsnol gdan stengs su/ /rnam shes gnas gyur pad+ma he ru ka /zhe sdang rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes dang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dga' bzhi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /bde stong zung 'jug shes rab thabs dang rol/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med khro mo'i sku/ /rgyud drug las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ma/ /khro mo gar dbang yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /ces pas bstod/ bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas ngag tu rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa gyen du kha phye ba'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyi sngags 'phreng kha dog dmar nag yig 'bru gyen du lang pas bskor ba/

de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar 'dres pa'i nyi ma'i 'od zer ram/ gser gyi ba thag 'dzings pa bzhin bun bun 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la sangs dag 'od zer ba spus bu ga dang / yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams sogs nas phyir 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sgrub sde chen po brgyad la sogs pa yi dam zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/ nyer spyod lnga la sogs pa phyi yi mchod pa/ sman raka gtor gsum sogs nang gi mchod pa/ sbyor ba dang sgrol sogs gsang ba'i mchod pa/ gnas lugs rang ngo shes pas mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod cing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad la 'od zer phog pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bye brag tu dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa rnams la 'od zer phog pa'i mod la tshar bcad thams cad dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi ngo bo 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang lhan cig tu mtsho la ser chen babs pa bzhin du rang la sib kyis thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur/ zhes brjod/ hrīḥ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /ge sar la ni snying po hrīḥ /'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa phul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdu/ /sems can sgo gsum sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim/ /zhes pa'i gsal btab nas rig pa ma yengs pa'i ngar dang bcas pas/

hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha yaṃ ghī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang / yum gyi thugs khar pad+ma'i lte bar ma yig 'dab ma la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdu gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes su/ 'dzab bstod ni/ hrīḥ pad+ma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog /dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /mi bzad khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /dbang drag stobs chen rngams brjid gtum/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'gying zhing brjid/ /dbu gsum rnam thar gsum yang ston/ /phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod/ /zhabs bzhi 'khor ba'i chos bzhi sgrol/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong sgrog /dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / 'dzab kyi dngos grub blang ba ni/ /hrīḥ khro rgyal dbang chen rta mchog dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las/ /mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ta krita pad+ma shwa ri ma hā kro dha ha yaṃ gh+ri wa mā ma trag mo dun+ting hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa nyer gcig brjod mthar/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi a la la hoḥ zhes brjod pas dngos grub thams cad rang nyid kyis thob cing brtan par bsam/ yig brgya lan 'og nas 'byung ba ltar pad+ma he ru ka'i yig brgya/ gsum bzlas/ mchod bstod sngar ltar bya/ rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi rjes ltar/ de nas kyai rdor mkha' spyod ma phyag rdor sogs kyi gtor bsngo byed na de dag dang gur zhal gyi gtor bsngo bskang ba rnams byas la phyag bzhi pa gtso 'khor rnams kyi gtor mar dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum brjod la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang du lha rnams sngon po'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag de'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las ral gris yu bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo dang khro mo chos skyong thams cad stobs dang nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas hūm̐ yig ral gri dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po ltar brjid cing / nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od 'phro ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas be te'i 'bras bu dang / g.yon gyi dang pos khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan pa'i ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dar nag gi stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis dpa' bo'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i steng gi cha la g.yas su gnod sbyin gang po dang / g.yon du mdzes ldan gnyis sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis kyis bum lha'i bdud rtsis gang zhing yid bzhin gyi nor bus kha brgyan pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhan yang mkha' lding /

bya nag mi nag ce spyang la sogs pas bskor ba/ de'i g.yon zur du pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du bh+yoḥlas tsaṇ+ḍi ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ spyan gsum dmar la bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis na mda' gzhu dang / dgra mgo 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang / gzig lpags kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ chos 'byung gi nang gi zur gsum du pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du g.yas zur du hūm̐ dang ral gri las sku'i sprul pa seng ge'i gdong pa can/ rab tu 'jigs shing g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon zur du dzaṃ dang gri gug las gsung gi sprul pa ce spyang gi gdong pa can mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gdong zur du kaṃ dang gri gug las thugs kyi sprul pa bya rog gi gdong pa can kha gdangs pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gsum ka'ang thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can drag cing rngams pa'i g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du hūm̐ brgyad las shar du bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ byang du khyung gi༞ nub tu khwa ta'i༞ lhor 'ug pa'i༞ mer phag gi༞ bden bral du khyi'i༞ rlung du ce spyang༞ dbang ldan du stag gi gdong pa can ste thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ drag mo shin tu khros pa zhabs gnyis gar thabs kyis me 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

chos 'byung phyi mi'i zur gsum du pad nyi'i steng du gdong zur du bhe las gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can g.yas rin po che dang g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa seng ge sngon po'i steng na bzhugs pa/ g.yas zur du ya las srog bdag bya rog gdong can g.yas dus kyi dbyug pa dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa ma he smug po'i steng na bzhugs pa/ g.yon zur du keṃ las bdud po bya rog gdong can g.yas chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / g.yon rwa'i mda' gzhu 'dzin pa stod mi la smad sbrul 'jug 'khyil pa lus thams cad mig gis spras pa/ gsum ka'ang drag cing rngam la gtum pa mi mgo'i phreng ba dang mi gdug pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris pa'o/ /chos 'byung phyi mi'i kha khyer la rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / phyi'i khor yug la mgon po bing 'dzin/ las mgon sde lnga/ e ka dza ṭī sngags srung nag mo la sogs pa thams cad kyang mi sdug pa'i cha lugs can mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ dur khrod brgyad du nag po stong sha za 'bum la sogs pas yongs su gang ba thams cad kyang drag po'i cha lugs can me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang rdo rje gdan/ nā len+d+ra/ bsil ba'i tshal nas ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe shākya seng ge'i spyan snga ru/ /mgon po khyod kyi ji ltar dam bcas bzhin/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las la spyan 'dren na/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā la tsa tur hasta sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs nas/

pad+ma ka ma lā ye satwaṃ/ zhes gdan phul/ oṃ ma hā kā la nas/ wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab/ dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang skur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang / 'khor rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res dbu rgyan par bsam/ gtor ma dang po gnyis mgon po dang lha mos gsol bar bsam la/ thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥmaṃ haṃ raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ shā sa na lan gsum/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye dā+e wi kā li kā li/ ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dzaḥ zhes pa'i mthar i daṃ bha liṃ ta sogs btags pa lan gsum gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs nas 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rdor dril 'dzin pa'am/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ rgya gar dbus kyi rdo rje gdan/ /'gyur med rgyun du brtan pa'i gnas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas byon pa'i yul/ /rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs na/ /gtsug lag khang chen nā len+d+ra'i/ /chos skyong srung mar mnga' gsol ba'i/ /ye shes mgon po bya rog mtshan/ /khrag 'thung rgyal ba'i sprul pa ste/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /nag po chen po mthu stobs can/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor/

/khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud/ /dgra bgegs ma lus rdul du rlog /bdud dgra 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo la/ bh+yoḥ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong / /'dab ldan rta bdun dbugs bral steng / /bh+yoḥlas byung ba'i tsaṇ+ḍi ka /dmar nag khros pa'i bzhin can bstod/ /g.yas gnyis ral gri rtse gsum 'phyar/ /g.yon gnyis mda' gzhu dgra mgo 'dzin/ /mi sdug rgyan dang rol stabs can/ /hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrogs drag mor bstod/ /chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs mkhas thugs rjes rnam 'phrul can/ /khro dang 'khrugs dang rngams pa yi/ /bgegs 'joms lha mo khyod la bstod/ /ces bstod do/ /gtor ma gsum pa gdong can rnams kyis gsol bar bsam nas/ oṃ ma hā kā li kā ka s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li s+hing s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li dzam+bu ka s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li gri dha s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li gha ru ḍa s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li kroṇ+ḍa ka kā s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li u lu ka s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li pu ka ra s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li shwa na s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li shrī kha mā s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li bya gh+ra s+yai hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sham du ba liṃ ta btags pa gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bya rog gdong can la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa sogs 'dra'o/ /bstod pa ni/ rdor dril lam rnga rol gang rung gis/ gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod do/ /gtor ma bzhi pa ni/ kha khyer ba sogs la phul te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs nas ba liṃ ta ye swāhā'i bar gsum gyi phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du sogs brjod/ rdor dril lam rnga rol gang rung gi bka' nyan pho nya bing 'dzin dang /

gdong can gsum dang gtsang rigs kyi/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs/ /sprul pa 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /phyi rol gnas pa'i dur khrod du/ /nag po'i gzugs can sha za dang / /ma mo gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i/ /las byed bka' nyan 'khor bcas bstod/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan che/ /phrin las mgon po 'khor bcas la/ /bdag gi gtor ma phul ba yis/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang dmod byed dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang / /rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams/ /nag po chen pos sgrol bar mdzod/ /ces brjod cing 'phrin las bcol/ bzlas pa bya bar 'dod na mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sngags gong du bshad pa bzhin la gtor sngags rnams bzhag nas ci rigs bzlas so/ /ma ning gi gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang chen por sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning nag po sku mdog mthing nag gtum zhing khros pa'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'bar ba'i ru mtshon rnon po gnam du 'phyar zhing / g.yon gdug pa can gyi snying dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ sbrul nag po'i ral pa mthur du 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ snying phreng dang sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber brtsegs mar gsol zhing / gser sked dang mi lpags rlon pas ska rag can/ tsan+dan gyi beng chen sked la btsugs pa'i sgo gsum nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung 'gyed pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i con paṇa lhab lhub dang / 'jigs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyi klubs pa/ g.yon brkyang gi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/

de'i g.yon du yum dpal 'bar ma dkar mo g.yas shel gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag gtso la stobs pa ma mo'i chas can rol pa'i stabs kyis 'gying ba/ g.yas su las mgon srog bdud nag po gri gug dang lcags par bzung nas mda' gzhu 'geng zhing kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor bkal ba stag ral dang gzig shubs btags nas bra nag rting dkar la chibs pa/ de'i phyi rol brtsibs drug la mdun nas g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin sku yi mgon po stag zhon nag po g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing gsor zhing / g.yon bdud kyi zhags pa thogs nas dpa' gtum stag la zhon pa/ gsung gi mgon po bing dmar smug g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing 'phyar zhing / g.yon bdud rtsi'i lcags par 'dzin pa/ thugs kyi mgon po gri gug mthing nag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yon tan gyi mgon po legs ldan nag po g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa seng ge la zhon pa/ 'phrin las kyi mgon po trag shad mthing nag g.yas bing gsol zhing / g.yon dgra snying bsnams pa/ bra nag rting dkar la chibs pa/ lnga ka'ang mi zad pa'i khro bo gtum drag 'jigs pa'i nyams can dar nag gi 'jol ber dang dur khrod rol pa'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan te baṃ gyi khar bzhugs pa/ 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma ti nag mo skem zhing sbom la gtum pa'i gzugs can g.yas khram shing 'phyar zhing g.yon bhañdza bzung ba'i mchan na nad skyal thogs pa ma mo'i chas brgyad kyi spras te rdzu 'phrul drel rta'i steng na btsan skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang ru 'dren gyi dmag dpon sde bzhi/ bka' sdod dregs pa sde brgyad/ myur mgyogs kyi pho nya las byed sogs srid gsum dregs pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang khros shing gtum pa'i nyams can mi sdug pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing 'bar ba'i me'i phreng ba drag por 'khrugs pa'i dbus na gnas pa'o/

/thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho nub rnga yab gling phran ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ri bo u tsa la yi dur khrod chen po rnams nas dpal ye shes mgon po ma ning nag po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs par bsam zhing / rdor dril lam rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs lha chen po/ /ma hā kā la mthu bo che/ /gsang ba'i khro rgyal stobs po che/ /ma ning nag po kun gyi rje/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /'og min gnas mchog dam pa dang / /gsang chen lhun grub gtsug lag khang / /dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas/ /thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /lha chen dpal 'bar gshegs su gsol/ legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs bdag chen poྎ ma ning nag poྎ srog bdud nag poྎ mkha' 'gro'i gtso moྎ mgon po sde lngaྎ sring gcig chen moྎ mthu chen sde brgyadྎ bdud 'dul dmag tshogsྎ ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐/ dur khrod rab 'jigs rngams pa'i gzhal yas dbus/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng / /rū tra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan khri la/ /khro rgyal ma ning 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu zhes pa dang / oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis dam la bzhag phyag bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ mnyam med mthu mnga' gtum chen me ltar 'bar/ /ma rungs 'joms mdzad bdud dpung thal bar rlog /mthar byed gzhon nu 'jigs pa'i gad rgyang can/ /ma hā kā la khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po 'khor bcas dgongs/

/khyed la dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /thod chen bhan+dha rlon pa'i snod mchog tu/ /ba ling gtor ma'i mchod pa rongs se rong / /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa brengs se breng / /rak+ta mar gyi ar+ghaṃ chi li li/ /dza gad gser skyems btung ba me re re/ /maṃ sa sha chen bsur dud thu lu lu/ /bhan+dha rus pa'i tshogs ni khra la la/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i bye brag dang / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/ /'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa sna tshogs kun/ /dpal mgon ma ning nag po 'khor bcas la/ /dang ba'i blo yis 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pā ri wā ra puṣ+pe nas shap+ta'i bar dang / a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tits+tsha swāhā zhes pa dang / khyad par du oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa/ na maḥsarba nas ba liṃ ta ye swāhā btags pa/ gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul la/ dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po bstan pa'i bka' srung chen po dpal mgon ma ning 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dus nas sngon byung ba/ /che mchog he ru ka dpal sku gsum rdzogs/ /srid rtse'i bdag 'dzin ru tra sde gsum 'dul/ /rtsal chen 'phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal chen mngon sprul nag po chen po'i sku/ /'chol ba'i khro rgyal ma ning dgra bgegs gshegs/ /lha chen dpal 'bar chos skyong yongs kyi rje/ /dmag dpon chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshub dkyil na/ /rnal 'byor dpal mgon khyed kyi cha lugs ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sku gsum ldan phyir spyan gsum gyen thur gzigs/ /rab brjid khro gnyer gsum ldan gtum la rngams/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs drag po'i skad sgra rdeb/

/rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /sbrul nag ral pa nag pos sa gzhi khyab/ /g.yas pa ru mtshon g.yon pa snying zhags bsnams/ /tsan+dan beng chen sked btsugs lha dmag 'gyed/ /thod pa skam rlon snying phreng sbrul chun spras/ /dar nag ber gsol gser sked mi lpags bcings/ /legs ldan nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūm̐/ las la chas tshe srog bdud cha lugs 'dzin/ srid gsum gzigs phyir spyan gsum brang la shar/ /dmag dpon bzhi 'gyed spyan bzhis lhu tshigs brgyan/ /stag ral gzig shubs btags nas rta nag zhon/ /bdud mda' dgra snying zor 'debs gling bzhi rgyug /spyan nas khrag 'dzag me yi kha rlangs 'bar/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ gri gug lcags par thogs nas su/ /snang srid pho brgyud thams cad pho nyar 'gyed/ /ci bcol las rnams skad cig yud la sgrub/ /rtag tu grogs mdzad mgon po nag po che/ /ma bskul bar yang brnag pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol/ /ltag na spyan gcig ma tshogs dbang du sdud/ /gar bskul sa ru mi ro rags su 'tsher/ /bzlog pas mi bzlog sngags bzlog mkhan gyi gshed/ gtsug lag khang srung dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod/ /bstan pa gnyen srung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /dregs pa kun 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūm̐/ dpal ldan las kyi mgon po ni/ /mthing nag gri gug lcags par thogs/ kha ṭ+wāṃ bdud mdas sgra snying gzir /rta nag zhon nas rgyug la bstod/ /ma gcig lha mo dpal 'bar ma/ /spu gri 'phyar zhing klad khrag ldag /mi lpags gos gyon thod phreng 'phyang / /u ma de wī'i sku la bstod/ /hūm̐/ sku las sprul pa'i mgon po ni/ /nag po stag zhon mi bzad pa/ /tsan+da bing gsor bdud zhags 'phen/ /gtum po 'jigs byed khyod la bstod/ /ma 'gags gsung gi rol pa'i rtsal/ /bing chen dmar smug khros pa'i zhal/ /tsan+da beng dang lcags par 'dzin/ /bdud 'dul mthu chen khyod la bstod/ /thugs kyi sgyu ma chen po'i 'phrul/

/lha min g.yul bzlog nag po che/ /phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams/ /khrag 'thung dpa' bo khyod la bstod/ /yon tan mgon po legs ldan che/ /gtum drag bzod dka'i gzi brjid can/ /mthing nag rin chen thod khrag 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ /'phrin las drag shul chen po'i rtsal/ /trag shad bdud mgon ma rungs pa/ /tsan+da bing dang dgra snying 'dzin/ /dgra bgegs gshed ma khyod la bstod/ /'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī/ /lag na khram shing thod pa 'dzin/ /drel rta zhon nas stong gsung nyul/ /nag po stong gi gtso la bstod/ /he ru ka dpal spyan snga ru/ /dam bcas ji bzhin da lta 'dir/ /bstan pa srung zhing skyong mdzad pa'i/ /dam can kun la bstod par bgyi/ /zhes bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyis thugs khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar srog sngags kyi bskor ba bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul bas ci 'dod pa'i 'phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du bsgrub par bsam la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gtso sngags te bye ba them na las kun 'grub/ ces pa bzhin rgyun par ci nus bzla'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ru pa tri yaṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ sku mgon no/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la rak+sha ru beng ni dzaḥ gsung mgon no/ /oṃ ma hā kā la k+ṣe ṭa ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ thugs mgon no/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la s+hing ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ yon tan mgon po'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la trag shad hūm̐ dzaḥ 'phrin las mgon po'o/ /de ltar gtso 'khor gyi 'gres sbyar nas ci rigs bzlas pa'i mthar mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod nas/ pra trits+tsha/ mchod cing 'phrin las gsol lo/ /swāhā'i bar dang / dpal ma hā kā la sogs gong bzhin no/ /rnam sras ni/ gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ yig las grub pa'i/

/rin chen snod du khaṃ yig zhu ba las/ /lha yi zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bai3/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /rgyal po chen po ngal bsos so/ /btsun mo sras dang 'khor gyi tshogs/ /bdag la brtse dgongs gnas 'dir gshegs/ /oṃ bai3 shrā ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ chos dbyings rnam dag pho brang 'dir/ /rin chen khri dang pad zla'i steng / /mi 'jigs gdong lnga 'gying ba la/ /rgyal chen 'khor bcas bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣ-iñtsa maṃ/ gtsang zhing ro brgya ldan pa yi/ /lha yi bdud rtsi dam pa 'di/ /'bul lo chos dbyings ngang du rol/ /brtse chen thugs rjes bdag skyongs shig /oṃ bai3 shra ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam lnga/ dug gsum dge tshogs las grub pa'i/ /rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis brgyad/ /rtags brgyad nye ba'i rin chen bdun/ /'dod yon sna lnga mchod yon dang / /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo mchod pa'i tshogs/ dngos su 'byor dang yid sprul pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dbul bar bgyis/ /bai3/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang / /sa brgyad sems dpa'i tshul bstan nas/ /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel mdzad pa/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /bdag ni deng nas byang chub bar/ /khyed la gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /g.yel ba med par sdong grogs mdzod/ /gnas skabs tshe dang bsod nams dang / /dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang phyug sogs/ /legs tshogs zla ba yar ngo ltar/ /gong nas gong du rgyas par mdzod/ /de nas chos bdag yang ni ber dang rdo rje'i mched mo rnams kyi mchod gsol sogs sngar srol bzhin byas la/ rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam spyi stabs gtor 'bul/

oṃ shrī pad+ma he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ pad+ma he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍi dho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān pad+ma he ru ka ma me muñtsa/ pad+ma he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pad+ma he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid mchod yul bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ rten med na/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /lag pa bsnol la mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs/ rang pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /ma rig ldongs pa'i sems can thams cad la/ /rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs par shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs bkra shis gang shes bya'o/ /lhag chad kha skong bzod gsol brtan bzhugs/ /gshegs gsol rnams ni rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar las/ /'di nang bzhin nges pa med cing 'dir bkod ni bsdus pa'i lugs so/ /zhes pa 'di yang lcags sbrul lo/ spu hrang dgon drug phyogs bsgril byas skabs bla ma dge 'dun bkra shis dang / der yod las tshan rnams nas chos srung mchod gsol khyer bde zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tshar chen chos kyis rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rta mgrin yang gsang rgyun khyer/
